## Change and provenance

- Development commit(s) / record:
- Affected workflow: Vina / easy-PPI / repository management
- Behavior and compatibility impact:

## Evidence

- Unit / integration test commands and outcomes (including skips):
- Real-case record, source PDB IDs, seeds, parameters, environment:
- Program / artifact integrity status:
- Scientific validation status and limitations:
- Redaction and repository guard result:

## Release review

- [ ] No structures, sessions, renderings, raw archives, environments or credentials
- [ ] No failed experimental algorithm is promoted as stable
- [ ] Existing Vina and easy-PPI behavior is preserved or explicitly reviewed
- [ ] Version, changelog and release evidence updated when publishing
- [ ] Scientific conclusions are supported; skips/failures are retained

Repository-management-only changes may cite unchanged scientific source hashes and
existing scientific records. Do not claim that CI reruns full docking benchmarks.
